children: Roku entered into a merger agreement to be acquired by Fox, with DOJ issuing an HSR second request delaying clearance.
Roku agreed to a two-step merger to become a wholly owned subsidiary of Fox via Merger Sub 1 and Merger Sub 2.
DOJ issued a Second Request on Sept 8, 2026, extending the HSR waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance.
Consummation expected in H1 2027, subject to HSR clearance, other customary conditions and shareholder approvals.
Registration Statement and Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus declared effective and mailed to shareholders on Sept 1, 2026.
